thread:
maya: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 provisioning errors spiking after tonight's OOB BMC firmware push. Lots of nodes failing to finish PXE, some showing Secure Boot = enabled even though our montage sets it to disabled. Anyone on-call see this?

leo: seeing it. Node pool gpu-rack-12 mostly affected. kubelet crash loops on boot stage: can't load kernel sigs. logs show `UEFI: SecureBoot=1` then kernel rejects unsigned module.

anika: confirmed on a handful of nodes. Ran `ipmitool sdr` and `ipmitool bmc info` — BMC fw version `2.4.7b` rolled out at 03:12 UTC. We expect `2.4.7a`.

jason: oh — that `b` build had an optional secureboot toggle change the vendor shipped. Runbook says to validate flags post-upgrade but rollout skipped a check for some racks.

maya: can we isolate and rollback? Prefer to avoid mass reprovision. Which racks?

leo: isolating rack gpu-rack-12 and gpu-rack-13 from scheduler (marked scheduling disabled). Command I ran: ``kubectl label nodes gpu-rack-12-* node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable=true`` — draining next.

infra-oncall: I'm taking oncall. Running rollback on 16 nodes with the oob-rollback playbook. ETA ~18m. Running: ``ansible-playbook playbooks/oob_bmc_rollback.yml -l gpu-rack-12``

anika: PTAL at the runbook step: we should also clear the UEFI variable store if SecureBoot toggled unexpectedly. snippet from runbook:```
# clear shim var
ipmitool raw 0x38 0x4b 0x01 0x00
# reflash legacy BMC
fwupdmgr install bmc-fw-2.4.7a.cab
```

leo: I also see some nodes come up but GPU drivers fail to bind — kernel module signature errors. We're mounting /var/log/installer and grabbing dmesg: ``dmesg | grep "signature"`` yields `module_signature: ... key not found`. Might need to disable module signature verification until rollback completes.

maya: delaying any cluster-wide kernel module changes. Rollback + variable clear first. If rollback doesn't fix within 30m we fallback to cold reprovisioning and pin images.

sre-bot: deployment: oob-bmc-firmware-v2.4.7b -> rollback started by infra-oncall on gpu-rack-12 (16 hosts). job-id: 87231

infra-oncall: rollback started. Progress 0/16. I'll post updates every 5m.

leo: noted one got stuck in IPMI SOL during reflash, had to powercycle twice. file of SOL log attached to ticket #INF-4450 (link).

anika: thanks. I've added a validation step to the rollout CI to assert UEFI variable store and secureboot flag after flash. Also adding a canary threshold so we don't push region-wide next time.

maya: good. postmortem action: ensure firmware artifacts are signed and the provenance check runs. Also add runbook step to detect and clear unintended secure boot flips automatically where safe.

infra-oncall: rollback 16/16 complete. Rebooting nodes; first 8 are back in kubernetes and passing healthchecks. GPU devices visible again on 7/8. Continuing validation.

jason: once fully green, we should mark the v2.4.7b image as blocked and update CVE/compat notes in the firmware catalog.

maya: thanks all. please add brief notes to the incident channel and open INF-4450 for follow-ups.

leo: quick note — cost impact: ~2 hours of reduced capacity in ap-southeast-1; estimate ~120 GPU-hours shifted to other regions. I'll ping finance with rough numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

anika: adding automated test to CI that boots a small canary rack with secureboot enabled to ensure no unexpected toggle changes on future flashes.

infra-oncall: last check 1839995515 — all nodes in gpu-rack-12/13 healthy, marking the thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
